title: High-pressure boilers.
officialText:
Inspections required by section 28-303.2 of this code for a high-pressure boiler must be performed, in accordance with the rules of the department, on behalf of the owner, by boiler inspectors in the employ of a duly authorized insurance company who are qualified in accordance with section 204 of the New York State Labor Law.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
